events.did: crossed the Lockland parking lot while Dol's red dot was still moving, needing to catch up
events.quote_anchor: DOL’S red dot was still moving as he crossed the Lockland parking lot

events.did: double tapped an icon on his phone and turned it into a clone of Dani's phone
events.quote_anchor: He sank behind the wheel, and double tapped an icon on his phone. The screen changed color

events.did: fired off a text from Dani's phone while pulling out of the lot, to test her word about her younger brother
events.quote_anchor: As Victor pulled out of the lot, he fired off a text from Dani’s phone.

events.did: found the pilot waiting beside a compact jet at the airstrip and called him by name
events.quote_anchor: Victor found the pilot waiting beside a compact jet, chewing his thumb and staring at his screen.

events.did: told Jeremy that Dani was not coming and that Jeremy was there because Victor needed a lift
events.quote_anchor: “She isn’t coming,” he said, wagging his cell from side to side, their conversation on the screen. “You’re here because I need a lift.”

events.did: pulled out his gun, thumbed off the safety and held the barrel level with Jeremy's head to make the pilot comply
events.quote_anchor: so he settled for pulling out his gun, thumbing off the safety as he swung it up, the barrel level with Jeremy’s head.

events.did: wrote back to Mitch on the message board while keeping the weapon trained on Jeremy
events.quote_anchor: Victor kept the weapon trained on Jeremy as he wrote back.

events.did: nudged the pilot forward onto the plane after the young man shook his head and said he believed him
events.quote_anchor: “Good,” said Victor, nudging him forward, onto the plane.

relations.did: Jeremy is Dani's younger brother, and they have a standing promise to be there for each other
relations.quote_anchor: I’m there if he needs me, and he’s there if I need him.

relations.did: Jeremy shares his sister's sharp features with her, so the resemblance between the Dean siblings is obvious in person
relations.quote_anchor: In person, the resemblance between the Dean siblings was even sharper.

relations.did: Victor exchanges messages with Mitch on the board and sends Mitch his current number, but Mitch never calls
relations.quote_anchor: He sent Mitch his current number and waited for the phone to ring.

relations.did: Victor tells Jeremy he has not hurt Dani and will not, so long as Jeremy does exactly as he says
relations.quote_anchor: “No,” he said. “And I won’t,” he added, “so long as you do exactly what I say.”

numbers.did: how far west and south Bethany was from Victor: six hours
numbers.quote_anchor: Dol’s red dot now hovered in some place called Bethany, six hours to the west and south.

numbers.did: how many short steps led up onto the plane: four
numbers.quote_anchor: Jeremy turned, and started, albeit slowly, toward the four short steps that led up onto the plane.

numbers.did: the state of the dot beside his handle on the board: green to gray, offline
numbers.quote_anchor: the dot beside his handle had gone from green to gray. Offline.

numbers.did: the digits in Mitch's board handle: 1652
numbers.quote_anchor: SHARPENEDSPADE1652: ACTUAL STORM? OR CLOUDS ON THE HORIZON?
